title: Senior IT Business Analyst
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
   

  

**A Day in the Life**
 The Product and IT teams at Medtronic collaborate to deliver innovative solutions that align with business strategy and drive meaningful outcomes.
   

  

 As a Senior Product Business Analyst, you will act as a key bridge between product, business, and IT teams, ensuring successful delivery of product initiatives. You will translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, enabling seamless collaboration across stakeholders and driving execution across the product development lifecycle.
   

  

 You will support product development by aligning business objectives with technology solutions, ensuring deliverables meet quality standards and strategic goals in a fast\-paced, global environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**
* Gather, analyze, and document business and product requirements
* Translate needs into user stories, use cases, and functional specifications
* Ensure requirements are complete, feasible, and aligned with business objectives
* Act as a liaison between product, business, and IT teams
* Facilitate cross\-functional collaboration and alignment
* Communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure solutions align with requirements
* Support design, development, and implementation phases
* Ensure alignment with product roadmap and business goals
* Develop and maintain high\-quality documentation including requirement specs and functional designs
* Maintain project artifacts and a single source of truth
* Prioritize features based on business value and urgency
* Manage and groom the product backlog with product owners
* Ensure backlog readiness for development execution
* Define acceptance criteria and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Track defects and ensure resolution before release
* Validate solutions meet business and quality expectations
* Analyze processes to identify improvement opportunities
* Evaluate solutions for effectiveness and efficiency
* Monitor performance metrics and recommend optimizations
* Align product initiatives with business strategy and goals
* Contribute to roadmap planning and data\-driven decisions
* Ensure delivery of intended business outcomes
* Operate with high ownership and autonomy
* Mentor junior and mid\-level analysts
* Influence decisions through stakeholder engagement and expertise


**Required Knowledge and Experience:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, IT, or related field
* 7–12 years of experience in business analysis or product\-focused roles
* Strong experience in requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment Nice to Haves
* Experience in product\-based or R\&D environments
* Exposure to enterprise systems and integration concepts
* Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, or similar
* Knowledge of process improvement methodologies and performance metrics
* Experience working in global, cross\-functional teams

title: Sr Manager, Security Analytics & Operations Senior (PL)
description:
Your opportunity
   

  

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region.
   

  

 The SOC Manager is the leader and program manager of the Security Operations Center, responsible for overseeing the entire 24/7 SOC program from a strategic and managerial level. This role ensures that the SOC’s people, processes, and technologies work in unison to detect and respond to cybersecurity threats effectively, especially critical in a high\-stakes financial environment where customer trust and regulatory compliance are paramount. The SOC Manager defines the SOC’s strategy and operating procedures, aligns the team’s objectives with the organization’s risk management and business goals, and communicates the SOC’s status and needs to executive leadership. In a financial industry context, the SOC Manager also plays a key role in ensuring compliance with industry regulations (such as PCI\-DSS or FFIEC guidelines) through well\-documented processes and by coordinating with risk and compliance teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Strategic Direction: Develop and drive the SOC’s strategy and roadmap. Define the scope of the SOC’s services (e.g., which threats to monitor, which assets to protect) in alignment with the organization’s business objectives and risk appetite. Regularly assess and update this strategy to address evolving cyber threats, new business initiatives, and changes in regulatory requirements.
* Team Leadership \& Development: Build and manage the SOC team to ensure 24/7 operational coverage and high performance. Oversee recruitment, training, and professional development of SOC personnel (analysts and team leads). Establish clear performance goals and career progression paths for team members, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and strong teamwork. Provide coaching and conduct performance evaluations.
* Operational Oversight: Oversee daily SOC operations and ensure the incident response program is functioning effectively at all times. Verify that the SOC is appropriately staffed, and that incident response playbooks and processes are well\-documented, tested, and adhered to during incidents. Organize regular drills or simulations (like cyber incident tabletop exercises) to test and improve the team’s readiness for various attack scenarios.
* Metrics \& Reporting: Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for the SOC, such as Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Respond (MTTR), incident volume trends, and analyst efficiency. Use metrics to gauge the SOC’s effectiveness and identify areas for improvement. Prepare and deliver regular reports and executive summaries highlighting the SOC’s activities, major incidents, and value delivered (e.g., threats detected and prevented) to senior management and other stakeholders. Communicate the organization’s security posture in business terms, translating technical details into risk and impact language that executives can understand.
* Process Improvement \& Technology: Continuously improve SOC processes and technology stack. Champion the integration of advanced security tools and automation to streamline operations (for instance, deploying a SOAR platform to automate repetitive tasks and orchestrate incident response actions). Evaluate and implement new security monitoring solutions or threat intelligence services to enhance detection capabilities.
* Regularly review and update incident response playbooks and SOPs for efficiency and relevance.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with peer teams and stakeholders across the organization. Work closely with IT infrastructure teams, application owners, compliance and legal departments, fraud investigation units, and others to ensure a unified approach to security. For example, collaborate with the Threat Intelligence team to ingest relevant threat intel into the SOC, or with Compliance/Legal in the event an incident has regulatory reporting implications. Foster strong communication channels so that the SOC is aware of upcoming changes (new systems, major business initiatives) and can adapt its monitoring appropriately.
* Risk \& Compliance Management: Ensure SOC activities meet regulatory and compliance requirements. In the financial sector, this includes maintaining robust audit trails of incidents, adhering to data privacy laws, and possibly reporting certain incidents to regulators. Develop and enforce policies and procedures that align with frameworks/standards (like NIST CSF, ISO 27001\) and industry regulations. Support internal and external audits by providing evidence of SOC controls and effectiveness.


 What you have
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Experience: 7–10\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with several years in a leadership role managing security operations or incident response teams. A background that includes climbing the ranks (e.g., from analyst to senior/lead) is ideal, as it provides both hands\-on technical experience and insight into effective SOC processes. Experience in the financial services industry or other large enterprises is highly valuable, given the scope and regulatory environment.
* Leadership \& Management Skills: Proven experience in leading and developing teams. This includes setting objectives, performance management, and mentoring. The SOC Manager should have experience managing a team with 24/7 responsibilities and an understanding of how to maintain team morale and effectiveness in a high\-pressure environment. Strong project management skills to drive initiatives (such as tool deployments or new process rollouts) from concept to completion.
* Technical Knowledge: Broad and deep understanding of security technologies and operations. Expertise with SIEM, EDR, and other incident response tools from an administrative/management perspective (e.g., ensuring proper deployment and health of these systems). Familiarity with network architecture, system administration, and security best practices across on\-premises and cloud environments. While the SOC Manager may not be involved in day\-to\-day analysis, they should be capable of understanding technical issues encountered by the team and providing guidance or resources.
* Strategic and Business Acumen: Ability to develop security operations strategies that align with business needs and risk management goals. This includes knowledge of risk assessment methodologies and understanding of how cybersecurity incidents can impact business operations, finances, and reputation. The SOC Manager should be adept at justifying investments in the SOC through metrics and business cases (e.g., demonstrating how improved detection and response reduces potential financial loss).
* Certifications: Security management or leadership certifications are strongly preferred, such as CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) or CISM (Certified Information Security Manager). These indicate a solid grasp of security governance, program management, and risk management. Relevant technical certifications at the expert level (e.g., GIAC GSLC/GSED, or vendor\-specific expert certifications) can also underscore the candidate’s technical credibility. An MBA or master’s degree in cybersecurity/information assurance can be a plus, reflecting further leadership and business training.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Financial Industry Expertise: Prior experience working in or with financial institutions’ security operations, acknowledging the unique threat landscape (e.g., fraud, insider threats, nation\-state actors) and stringent regulatory requirements (such as SOC audits, SOX, PCI, GLBA). Understanding of financial industry compliance and audit standards is extremely beneficial.
* Change Management \& Scaling Experience: Demonstrated success in scaling and maturing a SOC – for instance, having expanded a team, introduced new tiers, or improved a SOC from a basic operation to an advanced one. Experience leading organizational change (new processes, technology rollouts, or restructuring) in a security context is a strong plus.
* Innovation: A track record of implementing automation, machine learning, or other innovative solutions in security operations to improve efficiency and effectiveness. For example, deploying a new SOAR system or integrating advanced analytics into the SOC workflow.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Proven ability to work with and present to senior leadership (CISO, CIO, risk officers) and potentially external regulators or auditors. Comfort in providing assurance about the organization’s security posture and justifying SOC needs (budget, staffing) at the executive level.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.
   

  

**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**
* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check\-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day\-to\-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

title: Associate - Senior Business Process Specialist - Reporting [T500-29487]
description:
**About Deutsche Börse Group:** 




 Headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany, Deutsche Börse Group is a leading international exchange organization and market infrastructure provider. They empower investors, financial institutions, and companies by facilitating access to global capital markets.
 



 Their India centre is located in Hyderabad, serves as a key strategic hub and comprises India’s top\-tier tech talent. They focus on crafting advanced IT solutions that elevate market infrastructure and services. Deutsche Börse Group in India is composed of a team of capital market engineers forming the backbone of financial markets worldwide.
 



  





**Your area of work:** 




 Group Accounting is responsible for Deutsche Börse Group’s financial reporting under IFRS and HGB and serves as the central competence center for accounting\-related matters across the Group. The section defines accounting policies and standards, supports business initiatives with accounting expertise, and ensures high\-quality and compliant external financial reporting. In addition, Group Accounting plays a key role in M\&A transactions, capital management activities, and major finance transformation initiatives, including SAP migration, integration, and implementation projects across the Group. As a Business Process Specialist Finance Transformation, you will combine your accounting expertise with process improvement and transformation initiatives. You will work closely with Group Accounting, Controlling, Tax, Treasury, and IT to ensure that accounting requirements are appropriately reflected in future finance processes and systems. Within Group Reporting \& Analytics, you will help shape the future reporting landscape of Deutsche Börse Group. Acting as a bridge between Finance and IT, you will contribute your expertise in consolidation, financial reporting, data quality, and reporting processes to support strategic transformation initiatives and ensure consistent, reliable reporting across the Group.
 



  





**Your responsibilities:** 



* Act as a subject matter expert for Group Reporting, consolidation, and financial reporting processes
* Define and validate business requirements for reporting and analytics solutions from a Finance perspective
* Support finance transformation initiatives, including system implementations, migrations, and process harmonization activities related to Group Reporting
* Ensure that reporting requirements are consistently reflected in reporting processes, master data structures, and system configurations Internal
* Contribute to the design and improvement of reporting processes to support external financial reporting
* Support testing activities and business acceptance processes to ensure reporting requirements are accurately implemented
* Collaborate closely with Accounting, Controlling, Tax, Treasury, IT, and external implementation partners
* Monitor and enhance data quality, reporting consistency, and transparency across the reporting landscape
* Identify opportunities for process optimization, automation, and standardization within Group Reporting and Analytics.



  





**Your profile:** 



* University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field
* Several years of professional experience in Group Accounting, Consolidation, External Reporting, Financial Reporting, or a related finance function
* Strong understanding of accounting and reporting processes, particularly consolidation, month\-end and year\-end closing, and Group reporting
* Solid knowledge of IFRS and experience in preparing or supporting financial statements and disclosures
* Experience working with reporting and consolidation solutions such as SAP Group Reporting, Group Reporting Data Collection (GRDC), BW, SAC, or comparable platforms is advantageous
* Experience with SAP or other ERP/reporting systems as a key user, process owner, business expert, or project team member
* Exposure to finance transformation, reporting process improvements, system implementations, or migration projects is an advantage
* Strong understanding of financial data, reporting structures, master data, and reporting controls
* Excellent analytical skills and the ability to translate reporting requirements into practical business solutions
* Ability to work effectively across different finance functions and in international project environments
* Excellent communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills.

 At Orica, it’s the power of our people that leads change and shapes our futures. Every day, all around the world, our people help mobilise vital resources essential to progress. Established in 1874, we have grown to become the world leader in mining and civil blasting with a diverse of team of more than 13,000 across the world.
 



  





 It’s an exciting time to join us – we are shaping the future of mining through digital and automated technologies, embracing new ways of thinking, pioneering innovation and reimagining the way we work.

Working alongside operational, technical, commercial, supply chain, and finance teams, you will help ensure the efficient delivery of products and services while contributing to customer satisfaction and business performance.

* Coordinate customer\-facing commercial and operational activities to support the safe, efficient, and reliable delivery of products and services.

* Coordinate forecasting and planning activities to support customer requirements and business objectives.
* Prepare and maintain KPI reports, commercial analysis, customer performance reporting, and business dashboards.

* Monitor contract performance, customer commitments, and key commercial metrics.

* Track customer feedback, service\-related issues, and improvement opportunities to help drive positive customer outcomes.
* Collaborate with Commercial, Technical Services, Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to support customer and business needs.
* Contribute to budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives across the region.



  





**What you will bring** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* Mining Engineering, Mineral Engineering, or other engineering qualifications will be highly regarded.
* Engineering graduates and early\-career professionals are strongly encouraged to apply.
* Experience in mining, mining services, technical services, commercial support, account management, planning, business analysis, or customer\-facing roles is advantageous.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational and commercial data.
* Understanding of mining operations, drill and blast activities, production environments, or resource industries will be highly regarded.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and confidence working with data, reporting, and performance metrics.
* Experience with SAP, ERP systems, Power BI, or similar business systems is advantageous.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* A proactive mindset and willingness to build a career at the intersection of operations, customer engagement, and commercial performance.



  





**What we offer** 




  





 As part of a truly global company, you will have the ability to grow and learn in a diverse, collaborative culture. We foster relationships and learning through connected global and local teams, promote flexible and diverse career paths and support the development of your knowledge and skills.
 



  





 You will be paid a competitive salary, learn from talented individuals across multiple disciplines and be able to thrive in a safe workplace within a collaborative culture. Ignite your career at a place where your distinct potential can find its home.
 



  





**We respect and value all** 




  





 Orica promotes and fosters a culture of inclusion and Equal Opportunity Employment everywhere we operate. We treat our people and applicants with fairness, dignity, and respect, getting the best of everyone’s contributions. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, nationality, age, military or veteran, marital or disability status.

title: Project Control Specialist II
description:
**About Us**
 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
   

  

***As a Project Control Specialist II with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Lead and guide the Project Controls team for Schedule and Cost function on the Project.
* Work with Project leadership team in alignment and strategic discussions on the project.
* Develop and finalise the Project Controls Plan as per Project requirements and interface with Client and internal stakeholders.
* Lead and develop the Progress measurement system for the project based on the contractual reporting requirements and processes.
* Actively participate in Schedule development and guide the team to the required Planning and scheduling requirements.
* Conduct / lead Schedule workshops, IAP sessions and focus discussions on Schedule baselining and forecast exercises as required.
* Review, Tracking \& monitoring Schedule \& Critical areas through LEM and Scrums, raising the flag for the delays \& areas of concerns.
* Establish WBS and CBS required for the project as per the reporting requirements in line with the Client discussions.
* Interact with Project and department stakeholders in functional discussions and support required in delivering the Projects assigned.
* Preparation and analysis of Project performance statistics and analytics as appropriate.
* Lead to set up Project Cost reports, internal monitoring metrics and other reporting requirements.
* Monitoring \& controlling the cost by various analysis and time to time information Management about the risk areas.
* Performing Risk Analysis on the Schedule and provide inputs / recommendations.
* Generating various reports like Progress S\-curves, Lookahead Plan, Variance Analysis, Productivity Analysis.
* Invoicing, preparing Cash flow and presenting in the APEX monthly level meeting.
* Daily/Weekly/Monthly reports
* Attend Internal and Client review meetings as required to present the Project performance, Concerns, and recovery plans etc.
* Work closely with the Project and Engineering managers to ensure proactive approach on addressing project performance and recovery measures all times.
* Mentor and guide junior team members and impart knowledge transfer time to time.
* Participate internal innovative forums and contribute for the Digital growth in project delivery wherever possible.
* Preparation of project cost reports and provide forecast analysis and trends of the project.
* Liaise effectively with multidisciplinary teams, fostering collaborative relationships, and ensuring alignment between planning, execution, and project objectives.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* Tertiary qualifications in Graduate in Engineering/Technology.
* 8\+ years of experience in Working for similar type Projects/Industry experience.
* Proven leadership and communication skills
* Extensive experience in Oil \& Gas, energy sector \& Chemicals.
* Sound knowledge of Planning, Cost control and Monitoring.
* A dedication to client satisfaction
* Excellent relationship building and stakeholder management skills.
* You will be an enthusiastic team player, with excellent stakeholder management skills.
* Proactive thinking and solution\-oriented delivery.


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
   

  

 And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

This role plays a key part in designing, developing, and operating data pipelines that meet high standards for reliability, data quality, lineage, and governance.

 Build and support event\-driven data solutions using asynchronous, decoupled architectures to enable near real\-time processing and system scalability.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 Help us maximize the value of our software contracts while minimizing compliance risk across a global portfolio. You'll partner across teams to turn data into proactive actions ahead of renewals and negotiations.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Software Asset Optimization Owner (Associate) in Enterprise Software Management at JP Morgan Chase within Infrastructure Platforms, you manage global software assets, including license compliance against contractual rights and obligations, request fulfillment, maintenance renewals, contract negotiations, chargeback, global software catalog management, license key administration, and related processes and data governance.
   

  

 You help us stay strategic and proactive by identifying optimization opportunities and coordinating work across groups to maximize contract value while minimizing risk.
   

  

 You also contribute to financial forecasting and budget planning for the software contracts we manage by partnering with teams such as Sourcing, Finance, and the Product Owner.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Manage software licensing, contracts, and inventory, including researching and interpreting licensing models/terms and contract structures across major vendors (e.g., Microsoft, IBM, Oracle, Broadcom, SAP, Adobe) and other publishers
* Create and deliver software compliance reporting, including trends and insights to support cost control, pre\-audit readiness, and ongoing compliance
* Maintain accurate software and contract records across repositories and license management systems; monitor changes and assess/communicate downstream impacts
* Perform periodic internal compliance audits to reconcile entitlements (licenses purchased/rights granted) against deployments and consumption across physical and virtual environments, software\-as\-a\-service platforms, and third\-party cloud environments
* Partner with software product owners to determine strategy, optimize usage ahead of maintenance renewals and contract negotiations, and avoid unnecessary costs; support financial forecasting and budget planning for assigned contracts
* Coordinate with product owners, Vendor Management, Sourcing, and Legal to identify and remediate license gaps when consumption exceeds contractual entitlements
* Collaborate with the Software Discovery team to ensure discovery tools accurately and comprehensively detect software usage for assigned publishers; identify work, assign dates, follow up to ensure success, and drive optimal outcomes for internal customers
* Uses enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to speed up incident triage and trend analysis from operational signals, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements.
* Applies reuse\-first, AI\-assisted practices within incident/problem/change routines to identify recurring interruption patterns and support validated remediation actions aligned to resiliency and security expectations.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* 5\+ years of experience managing software assets across on\-premises, software\-as\-a\-service, and/or public cloud environments
* Experience with software asset management tools such as USU, Flexera, ServiceNow, or SamPro
* Experience reading, interpreting, and operationalizing software license agreements and contract terms (including entitlements, use rights, restrictions, and audit clauses)
* Experience creating compliance reporting and performing internal compliance audits/reconciliations (entitlements vs. deployments/consumption)
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ability to synthesize complex data into clear, concise insights
* Familiarity with software discovery tools (e.g., Application Discovery and Dependency Mapping, System Center Configuration Manager, Altiris) and/or inventory/configuration management database systems
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple teams to execute project goals; strong written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support production support workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to review and validate AI\-assisted incident recommendations before action, escalating when uncertain and following operational and security expectations.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Software Asset Management certifications from a recognized training provider
* Customer service mindset with a track record of delivering sustained high performance and customer satisfaction
* Ability to work well under pressure and interact effectively with varying levels of management
* Demonstrated ability to handle confidential information and communications appropriately

title: Portal Data Analyst
description:
JSM is seeking a contract Data Quality Analyst to help us raise the quality of the data underpinning our product. Data quality directly affects the reliability, security, usability, and trustworthiness of what we deliver to our users, and data accumulated over the past 9 years has eroded some data quality. This role will focus on projects and customer accounts that have been non\-functional for five years or more, yet they — along with their dependent data — that persist in our active systems. The introduction of a new ERP system provides more opportunities to clean data related to customers and their access. We need an expert who can extract data from existing databases, use various fields and queries to identify functional areas and dormant data, determine what can be archived or removed, and more broadly make recommendations to improve overall data quality and maintenance practices. Working alongside the Product Owner and functional stakeholders, this role will assess the current state of our data, diagnose the root causes of quality issues, and recommend the right set of improvements — from identifying and retiring obsolete data to normalization, standardization, de\-duplication, and correction. This is a business\-outcome driven role: the objective is to have measurably better, leaner, more trustworthy product data. Familiarity with Maximo, Windchill, or the marine/maritime domain is a strong advantage.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Identify dormant and obsolete data. Find functional areas that have been inactive for extended periods — five years or more — and map the dependent data tied to them, so we know exactly what can be safely archived or removed.
* Understand our product data. Study the data that powers our product — across primary and related data sets — and build a clear picture of its structure, relationships, and dependencies.
* Tell us where we stand. Assess data quality against the dimensions that matter to us — accuracy, completeness, consistency, uniqueness, validity, and integrity — and give us an honest, evidence\-based view of the current state.
* Find the root cause, not just the symptom. Explain why quality issues recur, so we can fix the source, not just the surface.
* Define what "good" looks like. Help the product team establish data quality standards and success measures we can hold ourselves to.
* Recommend the right improvements. For each issue, prescribe the appropriate remedy — archival or removal of obsolete data, normalization / restructuring, de\-duplication, standardization, correction, or enrichment — with clear rationale, business impact, and priority.
* Protect what depends on the data. Map how our data relates across tables and systems so that any archival, removal, or improvement preserves integrity and doesn't disrupt downstream product behavior or reporting.
* Show the improvement. Define quality metrics and demonstrate measurable before\-and\-after improvement.
* Help us sustain quality. Recommend the rules, validations, and standards that keep quality from degrading again after the engagement ends.
* Leave us self\-sufficient. Document findings, decisions, and improvement logic so the product team can carry the work forward.


**What You Will Need:**
 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Graduate with Min of 9 years of experience as Data Quality Analyst
* Experience in Marine Industry will be an added advantage


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
* Proven track record improving data quality for a product, platform, or enterprise system.
* Experience identifying obsolete, dormant, or redundant data and defining safe archival / removal approaches.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with the discipline to spot subtle data inconsistencies, trace dependencies carefully, and validate findings before recommending changes.
* Strong grasp of data quality dimensions and the ability to translate them into terms the product team and business stakeholders understand.
* Solid understanding of how data is structured and related — normalization principles and dependency mapping across primary and related data sets.
* Sound judgement on which remedy fits which problem, balancing effort against business value.
* Ability to profile and analyze data independently and turn findings into clear, prioritized recommendations.
* A consultative, product\-minded approach — comfortable advising stakeholders, framing trade\-offs, and driving decisions.
* Ability to work independently and ramp up quickly with minimal supervision.


**Good to Have**
* Working knowledge of IBM Maximo (asset / EAM data) or PTC Windchill (PLM data).
* Familiarity with the marine, maritime, or classification\-society domain.
* Experience with master data management (MDM), data governance, or data quality frameworks.

**About The Role**
 The Project Controls, Engineering Analytics \& Bid Review will be based in AIN and will be part of the Project Controls organization within Amgen Engineering. This role will report to the Senior Manager – Capital Equipment Analytics and will support capital equipment analytics and bid review activities across global capital projects.
   

  

 This role will combine project controls, analytics, reporting, and capital equipment bid review experience to improve cost visibility, supplier comparison, equipment demand insights, and decision support. The Project Controls Analytics role will help structure bid information, analyse supplier proposals, support benchmarking, and develop analytics outputs that improve project planning, equipment delivery visibility, and risk identification.
   

  

 The role will also support compliance to established project controls, procurement, and reporting processes by maintaining reliable data, clear analytical assumptions, and audit\-ready supporting documentation.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* Support capital equipment bid review, including cost comparison, schedule / lead\-time review, scope completeness, assumptions, exclusions, and risk indicators.
* Support benchmarking by comparing current bids against historical project and equipment data to identify cost trends, variance drivers, supplier differences, and forecasting inputs.
* Support reporting, analytics, and decision\-support tools that improve visibility into equipment demand, spend, bid comparisons, supplier risks, delivery milestones, and lifecycle status.
* Support the equipment data foundation by collecting, validating, and maintaining bid, supplier, cost, demand, schedule, delivery, and lifecycle data.
* Maintain audit\-ready analysis files, data records, assumptions, and supporting documentation in alignment with established project controls and procurement processes.
* Use digital, automation, and AI\-enabled tools to improve analysis quality, reporting efficiency, data review, and insight generation.
* Partner with Project Controls, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, and project teams to gather inputs, validate assumptions, and align analytical outputs.
* Support bid review templates, reporting standards, analytics methods, and data quality practices.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent).
* 5–9 years of work experience in Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field
* Experience in the global pharmaceutical industry preferred.


**Functional Skills**
* Project controls and analytics experience in a capital project, engineering, procurement, or estimating environment.
* Support bid review, cost comparison, benchmarking, forecasting, reporting, or supplier proposal analysis.
* Ability to review capital equipment bids and interpret cost, scope, schedule, assumptions, exclusions, delivery risks, and comparison points.
* Experience with digital tools for reporting and analytics such as Power BI, advanced Excel, SAP, procurement / sourcing systems, data structuring, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of data integrity, process compliance, documentation discipline, and audit readiness in project controls, analytics, or procurement\-related workflows.
* Understanding of capital project cost, schedule, procurement, and supplier delivery information.
* Ability to partner effectively with Engineering, Project Controls, Procurement, Finance, and project teams.

* Experience supporting capital projects in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, advanced manufacturing, or other regulated industries.
* Experience working with capital equipment, supplier bids, procurement data, or equipment lifecycle information.

* Experience developing bid review templates, reporting standards, data models, or analytical tools.
* Familiarity with automation, advanced analytics, data quality improvement, or scalable reporting practices.

* Relevant certification in project management, project controls, cost management, analytics, engineering, or a related discipline

description:
**Business Analyst, Officer, Interfaces**
****Job Description****
**What we are looking for**
 We are seeking a
 **Business Analyst** 
 responsible for bridging business, product, and technology teams to deliver innovative solutions across Charles River Investment Management System (IMS) and related front, middle, and back\-office workflows. This role plays a critical part in defining product capabilities, gathering and documenting requirements, validating functionality, and ensuring the successful delivery of solutions that meet client and business needs.
   

  

 The Business Analyst will become a subject matter expert in Charles River products and investment workflows, partnering closely with clients, product managers, engineers, quality assurance, and implementation teams throughout the software development lifecycle. Working within a feature\-focused Agile team, they will leverage both financial industry expertise and technical knowledge to analyze complex business processes, define functional requirements, troubleshoot issues, and drive enhancements that improve the overall client experience.
   

  

 This role requires a combination of strong analytical skills, financial market knowledge, technical aptitude, and the ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders. The successful candidate will be comfortable operating in a fast\-paced environment, managing multiple priorities, and independently driving initiatives from concept through delivery.
   

  

**Why this job is important to us**
 Charles River Development brings together data and capabilities across the investment lifecycle to help our clients make better decisions, grow at scale, and deliver returns for their clients. Our diverse team of highly skilled technologists and professionals are agile thinkers and problem solvers, committed to our end users and engineering excellence. We use mentorship and teamwork to impact and drive our business forward every day.
   

  

 By joining the Charles River Product Development team, you will work at the intersection of financial technology and investment management, helping shape products that power some of the world's largest asset managers, asset owners, and financial institutions. You will collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions that streamline investment operations, improve data accuracy, and enable better investment decisions.
   

  

 At Charles River Development (CRD), we've been creating some of the most insightful and sophisticated investment management technologies since 1997\. Through our commitment to product quality and client success, we've experienced continuous growth. Charles River IMS is strategically aligned to innovate the future of investment management technologies. Together with State Street's middle and back\-office capabilities, Charles River's cloud\-deployed software technology forms the foundation of State Street Alpha℠.
   

  

****Responsibilities:****

* Research, analyze, and produce comprehensive business and technical requirement documents.
* Analyze middle\-office and back\-office investment management workflows and create detailed functional specifications.

* Collaborate with implementation and support teams to troubleshoot, reproduce, and resolve escalated client issues.

* Assist with Jira work item creation, refinement, prioritization, and tracking.
* Participate in integration testing activities and environment setup as required.
* Work closely with Quality Assurance teams to review and approve test plans, test cases, and validation results.
* Coordinate across engineering, QA, support, implementation, and product management teams to ensure successful and timely product releases.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and potential implementation challenges, proactively driving resolution to maintain project momentum.


****Requirements:****
* 10\+ years of experience working within the software development lifecycle, preferably in Agile environments.
* Strong experience analyzing investment management workflows, particularly middle\-office functions including position and tax lot reconciliation.
* Familiarity with financial instruments including equities, fixed income, foreign exchange, derivatives, and related asset classes.
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, including negotiation and stakeholder management.
* Advanced writing skills with the ability to abstract and summarize highly detailed technical and business information.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to reconcile conflicting requirements and data sources.
* Ability to translate business needs into detailed functional and technical requirements.
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to collaborate effectively with software engineering teams.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL); familiarity with ETL technologies such as Kettle or Talend is a plus.
* Demonstrated planning, organization, and scheduling skills.
* Ability to independently learn new domains, remove obstacles, and proactively drive progress.

* Proven ability to produce comprehensive business, functional, and technical specification documents.
* Experience working directly with clients to gather requirements and validate solutions.
* Knowledge of one or more Charles River functional areas is strongly preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Education: BS Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or study of Business with an MIS background. MS/MBA degree strongly preferred

title: Analyst Data & Insight
description:
**Overview**
 Founded in 1988, Trimont (www.trimont.com) is a specialized global commercial real estate loan services provider and partner for lenders and investors seeking the infrastructure and capabilities needed to help them scale their business and make informed, effective decisions related to the deployment, management and administration of commercial real estate secured credit. As the largest master servicer of commercial real estate loans in the United States, Trimont manages securitizations with meticulous oversight and coordination—protecting cash flows, mitigating risk, and ensuring portfolio performance.
   

  

 We do this with a team of 1100\+ extraordinary team members who serve a global client base from offices in Atlanta (headquarters), Bengaluru, Charlotte, Dallas, Hyderabad, Kansas City, London, New York and Sydney. We empower our people with advanced technology, industry\-leading knowledge, and a culture centered on our core values. This approach enables our teams to deliver exceptional client service, build lasting relationships and take pride in the high\-quality work they perform.
   

  

 Trimont is an innovative firm where visionary professionals come to learn, grow, and thrive with colleagues driven by curiosity and collaboration.
   

  

**Learn:** 
 We believe ongoing learning is critical and are focused on providing a work environment where all team members can take ownership of their careers.
   

  

**Grow:** 
 We work alongside the largest institutional lenders in the world, overseeing the most significant projects in the industry. This unique opportunity allows us to broaden our skillset and develop our abilities by tackling some of the industry’s most challenging and exciting endeavors.
   

  

**Thrive:** 
 Our firm is a place where ethics and excellence meet to create an experience that matches our capabilities. There are no limits to what we as team members and as an organization, can achieve together.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a highly analytical and business\-focused
 **Analyst Data \& Insights Professional** 
 to transform raw data into actionable insights that inform strategic decision\-making. This high\-impact role sits at the intersection of
 **data analytics, business intelligence, automation, and GenAI\-enabled insight generation** 
 .
   

  

 The ideal candidate will champion a
 **data\-driven and AI\-aware culture** 
 , mentor others, and continuously evolve analytics capabilities using modern tools and responsible AI practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Insights \& Strategy**
* Transform complex data into actionable insights that support strategic and operational decision\-making.
* Identify trends, outliers, and key performance drivers across functions using advanced analytics, structured querying, and AI\-enabled techniques.
* Develop executive\-ready dashboards and reports with strong narrative context and clear recommendations.
* Leverage GenAI tools to accelerate insight discovery, analysis, and storytelling where appropriate.


**Reporting \& Analytics Excellence**
* Own the full reporting lifecycle: data sourcing, SQL\-based data modeling, automation, validation, visualization, and enhancement.
* Write, optimize, and maintain complex, performant SQL queries and reusable datasets.
* Ensure consistency, accuracy, and clarity in reporting outputs.
* Define and govern data definitions, metric logic, and standards to maintain a single version of the truth, including responsible use of AI\-generated outputs.


**Tools, Automation \& Platform Development**
* Design, build, and maintain Power Apps solutions to streamline data capture, workflows, and business self\-service.
* Use VBA to automate repetitive reporting tasks, data preparation, and operational workflows.
* Apply Python for data analysis, transformation, and exploratory analytics as needed.
* Integrate Power Platform, BI tools, and AI\-enabled capabilities to deliver scalable and intuitive analytics solutions.
* Apply GenAI fundamentals such as prompt design, insight validation, and workflow augmentation to improve productivity and reporting efficiency.
* Continuously evaluate and enhance the BI and analytics ecosystem, including emerging AI and GenAI capabilities.


**Innovation, Enablement \& Leadership**
* Mentor analysts and business partners on advanced SQL, analytical thinking, GenAI fundamentals, and effective insight development.
* Explore opportunities in predictive analytics, forecasting, and AI\-assisted modeling to move from descriptive to prescriptive insights.
* Stay current on GenAI trends and responsible AI practices, assessing applicability to analytics and decision support.
* Promote best practices, reusable assets, and standards to strengthen a data\-driven culture.


**Required Qualifications**
* 0\-1 year of hands\-on experience in analytics, business intelligence, or reporting roles
* Strong expertise in SQL, including complex query development, optimization, and dataset modeling
* Proven experience building high\-quality Power BI dashboards with strong performance and business context
* Demonstrated ability to analyze data to identify trends, outliers, and performance drivers
* Experience managing the end\-to\-end reporting and analytics lifecycle
* Working knowledge of Power Apps and the Power Platform for data capture, automation, or self\-service
* Basic proficiency in VBA and Python for data analysis, reporting automation, and workflow efficiency
* Exposure to GenAI tools or analytics copilots, including prompt design and validation of AI\-generated insights
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate analysis into concise, executive\-ready narratives
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent experience)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced Power BI skills, including data modeling, DAX, and performance optimization
* Experience defining data governance standards and metric frameworks
* Hands\-on use of GenAI to augment analytics workflows (insight discovery, summarization, narration)
* Exposure to forecasting, trend analysis, or basic predictive analytics
* Experience in financial services, operations, SaaS, or enterprise analytics environments
* Strong background working with large datasets and multiple data sources
* Understanding of responsible AI practices, including validation, bias awareness, and data privacy


 Trimont is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud to support and celebrate diversity in the workplace. If you have a disability and need an accommodation or assistance with the application process and/or using our website, please contact us. We are proud to maintain a drug\-free policy, ensuring that our community is a secure and productive space for all our team members.

description:

 CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting\-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.
 



  





**What CIBC India Offers:** 




 At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.
 



 We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance\-based incentive programs, a family\-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points\-based recognition program.
 



 Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide
 



 We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing (Position Summary):** 




 As a Business Intelligence Consultant, you will play a key role in modernizing business reporting and analytics at CIBC. This role sits within the business intelligence function and is focused on reporting, dashboarding, analytics, and migration of business reporting assets to cloud\-based environments.
 



 You will work closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, translate requirements into effective dashboards and analyses, and support the modernization of legacy SAS/SQL reporting solutions into Python\- and BI\-based reporting assets.
 



 This is not a backend ETL pipeline engineering role. The primary focus is on business reporting, analytics, dashboard development, ad hoc analysis, and migration of business\-owned reporting assets, logic, and code to modern reporting environments.
 



 At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.
 



  





**How You’ll Succeed:** 




**Business Intelligence \& Reporting Delivery:** 



* Deliver business intelligence solutions including recurring reports, dashboards, scorecards, and ad hoc analyses that support business decision\-making.
* Build, enhance, and maintain management reporting and self\-service dashboards for business users and leadership teams.
* Use Power BI or Tableau to create clear, scalable, and business\-friendly visual reporting solutions.

* Partner directly with business stakeholders to gather requirements, understand reporting priorities, define KPIs and metrics, and validate outputs.
* Translate business questions into actionable reporting and analytics solutions.
* Communicate insights and reporting logic clearly to business audiences.
* Reporting Modernization \& Migration
* Support the migration of legacy business reporting assets and SAS/SQL\-based reporting processes into modern cloud\-based reporting solutions.
* Convert and simplify legacy reporting logic into SQL and Python\-based workflows for reporting and analysis.
* Help modernize business\-owned reports, dashboards, and analytical code while preserving business logic and reporting accuracy.



  





**Data Analysis \& Preparation:** 



* Use SQL and Python to source, prepare, reconcile, validate, and analyze data for reporting purposes.
* Perform data checks and reconciliations to ensure reports are accurate, complete, and reliable.
* Apply sound business logic and data interpretation to reporting outputs.



  





**Governance \& Quality:** 



* Ensure reporting outputs align with data governance, control, and quality standards.
* Document assumptions, calculations, metric definitions, and reporting logic as needed.
* Identify opportunities to improve report quality, usability, and efficiency.



  





**Collaboration:** 



* Work with business, analytics, and technology partners to enable reporting solutions and resolve data or reporting issues.
* Collaborate across teams while maintaining a primary focus on business intelligence delivery, not pipeline engineering or infrastructure ownership.



  





**Continuous Improvement:** 



* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive reporting activities and streamline reporting workflows.
* Stay current with BI and analytics best practices and recommend improvements to reporting processes and tools.
* Use AI or automation tools where appropriate to support report migration, code conversion, and quality assurance.



  





**Who You Are:** 



* 7\+ years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, MIS, or business\-facing data roles
* Strong hands\-on proficiency in SQL and Python
* Strong experience building dashboards and business reports using Power BI or Tableau
* Proven experience working with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver reporting solutions
* Experience with legacy reporting environments such as SAS and/or SQL\-based reporting assets
* Strong understanding of KPI development, report logic, reconciliation, and data quality validation
* Ability to translate business needs into dashboards, metrics, and analytical outputs
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills
* Exposure to Azure and Databricks is a nice\-to\-have, not required
* Experience using AI or automation tools to support reporting migration or reporting quality is an asset.



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile:** 




**We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience in:** 



* Business Intelligence Reporting
* Management reporting
* Dashboard development
* Ad hoc analytics
* Report migration / reporting modernization
* Stakeholder\-facing analytics delivery
* KPI and performance reporting
* Candidates whose background is primarily in ETL pipeline development, source\-to\-target data engineering, or cloud infrastructure management without strong business intelligence delivery experience may be less aligned to this role.

 Individual contributor role focused on delivering business reporting and analytics solutions that support business unit goals High interaction with business stakeholders and reporting consumers Strong emphasis on reporting outcomes, dashboard usability, data quality, and insight generation Compliance Requirements Comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines, and controls

title: Senior Business Intelligence Consultant [T500-29450]
description:
**About CIBC:**

Client relationships are at the center of our strategy, and our growth is enabled by a highly engaged and connected global team. From digital banking to community impact, we’re proud to drive progress for our clients and our communities. Recognized for our culture, award\-winning innovation and community investment, CIBC continues to evolve by putting people and progress at the centre of everything we do.
 



  





**About CIBC India:** 




 CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting\-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.
 



  





**What CIBC India Offers:** 




 At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.
 



 We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance\-based incentive programs, a family\-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points\-based recognition program.
 



 Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide
 



 We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing (Position Summary):** 




 As a Senior Business Intelligence Consultant, you will lead the modernization of business reporting and analytics at CIBC, partnering closely with the Analytics Head Office in Toronto and key business stakeholders.
 



 This role sits within the business intelligence function and is focused on business reporting, dashboarding, analytics, and migration of business\-owned reporting assets and logic to modern cloud\-based environments. You will help transform legacy SAS/SQL reporting into scalable, business\-ready reporting solutions using SQL, Python, and Power BI or Tableau.
 



 This is not a backend ETL pipeline engineering role or a source\-system data migration role. The primary focus is on management reporting, dashboard development, ad hoc analysis, reporting logic modernization, and business insight delivery.
 



 At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.
 



  





**How You’ll Succeed:** 



* Reporting \& BI Solution Leadership.
* Lead the modernization of legacy reporting assets and deliver business\-ready reporting solutions that support decision\-making.
* Own the development and enhancement of dashboards, scorecards, recurring management reports, and ad hoc analyses.
* Deliver reporting solutions that are accurate, scalable, user\-friendly, and aligned to business priorities.



  





**Business Partnership:** 



* Partner closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, define KPIs and metrics, and translate business questions into actionable reporting solutions.
* Act as a trusted advisor on reporting design, metric interpretation, and business insight delivery.
* Present findings, reporting logic, and recommendations clearly to business audiences.
* Reporting Migration \& Modernization
* Lead the migration of business reporting assets, SAS/SQL\-based reporting logic, and analytical workflows into modern cloud\-based reporting solutions.
* Convert legacy reporting code and logic into SQL\- and Python\-based solutions that preserve business meaning and reporting integrity.
* Rationalize, simplify, and modernize legacy reports and reporting processes for improved usability and efficiency.



  





**Dashboarding \& Analytics:** 



* Develop advanced dashboards and business intelligence reports using Power BI or Tableau.
* Use SQL and Python for analysis, reporting logic, reconciliation, validation, and data preparation in support of reporting outcomes.
* Deliver ad hoc analysis and insight generation for business and leadership teams.
* Data Quality, Controls \& Governance
* Ensure reporting outputs are accurate, complete, traceable, and aligned to governance standards and controls.
* Document business logic, metric definitions, assumptions, and key transformations as needed.
* Identify and resolve data quality issues that affect reporting integrity.



  





**Stakeholder \& Team Leadership:** 



* Build strong relationships with business partners, analytics teams, and related stakeholders across functions.
* Coach and support team members or junior analysts as appropriate, fostering strong reporting and analytical practices.
* Contribute thought leadership on BI/reporting modernization and business value delivery.
* Continuous Improvement
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive reporting activities and improve reporting workflows.
* Use AI or automation tools where appropriate to support code conversion, reporting quality checks, and productivity gains.
* Recommend improvements to reports, dashboards, business processes, and reporting operating models.



  





**Experience:** 



* 10\+ years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, MIS, or business\-facing data roles.
* Strong experience delivering management reporting, dashboards, ad hoc analysis, and KPI\-based reporting.
* Proven experience modernizing or migrating legacy reporting assets, including SAS/SQL\-based reporting logic.
* Strong track record of working directly with business stakeholders to define and deliver reporting solutions.
* Experience leading or significantly contributing to reporting transformation or reporting modernization initiatives.
* Experience using AI tools or automation in reporting migration, reporting quality assurance, or analytics workflows is an asset.



  





**Who You Are:** 



* Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Power BI or Tableau; one of these should be a core strength.
* Deep experience in business reporting, dashboarding, analytics, and stakeholder\-facing insight delivery.
* Strong understanding of KPI development, metric definition, reconciliation, and reporting controls.
* Ability to translate business requirements into practical, high\-quality reporting solutions.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated leadership capability, including coaching, mentoring, or leading workstreams.
* Experience with SAS and legacy reporting environments is strongly preferred.
* Exposure to Azure and Databricks is a nice\-to\-have, not a core requirement.
* Familiarity with automation and AI\-enabled productivity tools is an asset.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Exposure to Azure\-based analytics environments.
* Databricks familiarity.
* Experience with business reporting migration into cloud\-based reporting platforms.
* Experience with both Power BI and Tableau.
* Financial services or regulated industry reporting experience.



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile:** 




**We are particularly interested in candidates with backgrounds such as:** 



* Senior Business Intelligence consultant.
* Reporting and analytics lead.
* BI developer / BI analyst with strong business engagement.
* MIS / management reporting lead.
* Dashboard and KPI reporting specialist.
* Reporting modernization lead.
* Candidates whose experience is primarily in ETL pipeline development, data ingestion, backend data engineering, cloud infrastructure, or source\-to\-target migration without strong business intelligence and reporting delivery experience may be less aligned to this role.



  





**Privacy:** 




 By proceeding with the creation of a profile and submitting an application in response to this job posting, you acknowledge and agree that your personal data will be collected, used, retained and disclosed by CIBC India and its affiliates, as described in the Candidate Privacy Statement.

title: Quality Specialist II
description:

**Purpose :** 
 Performs comprehensive quality analysis across region by evaluating performance metrics, trends, and compliance with quality standards. Translates data into actionable insights through structured reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) to support continuous improvement, operational excellence, and informed decision\-making.
   

  

**The Role**
***As a Quality Specialist II with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

+ Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and best practices in quality management and reporting.

* Data Governance \& Integrity:
+ Ensure quality, accuracy, and integrity of data used in reports and dashboards.

+ Maintain documentation of reporting methodologies and definitions.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Business, or related discipline.

* Experience in design of dashboards, KPIs, reporting and data analytical tools.

* Ability to convert data into meaningful insights and executive\-level presentations.

* Knowledge of quality system (e.g.ISO 9001\).
* Experience in Quality Management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in quality reporting, data analysis, or performance management.
* Proficiency in data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel, etc.).
* Ability to convert data into meaningful insights and executive\-level presentations.

 The Workday Reporting Senior Analyst is a senior lead within the ES Data Operations team, based in Hyderabad. Serving as the subject matter expert on all facets of Workday reporting, the Senior Analyst manages the full lifecycle of complex reporting requests—from requirement gathering, strategic consultation, and data architecture analysis to building, delivering, and governing reports.  The responsibilities of the Workday Reporting Senior Analyst include but are not limited to the following:
   

  

* Advanced Design and Development: Architect, build, test, and deploy complex Workday Custom Reports across all report types—including Advanced, Matrix, Composite, BIRT (Business Intelligence and Reporting Tools) tailored to strategic enterprise requirements.
* Calculated Fields Architecture: Design and troubleshoot highly complex Workday Calculated Fields and logic to power advanced analytics, multi\-level reporting, and cross\-functional metrics.

* Report \& Release Management: Proactively maintain and optimize existing reports. Own the evaluation, testing, and continuous alignment of reports during Workday's bi\-annual feature releases and system updates.
* Complex Data \& Root\-Cause Analysis: Conduct deep\-dive analysis on multi\-dimensional HR datasets to uncover hidden trends, perform root\-cause analyses on data anomalies, and ensure high\-level data accuracy before delivery.
* Troubleshooting \& Performance Tuning: Act as an escalation point for resolving complex report performance bottlenecks, access issues, and data discrepancies within the Workday reporting and security framework.
* Process Leadership \& Mentorship: Lead team\-wide reporting optimization initiatives, promote best practices in report design, and provide functional guidance and technical mentorship to junior team members.
* Comprehensive Documentation: Maintain clear, audit\-ready process documentation for complex reports, automation workflows, data definitions, and governance protocols.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 5\+ years of professional experience in HR Data Operations, Business Intelligence, or Analytics, with at least 3\+ years specializing directly in advanced Workday Reporting.

* Mastery across all Workday report types (Advanced, Matrix, Composite, BIRT, etc).
* Advanced capability in designing, nesting, and optimizing complex Workday Calculated Fields.
* Deep understanding of Workday Business Objects, Data Sources, and domain relationships across Workday HCM, Absence, Compensation, Talent, Payroll, Benefits, and Recruiting.
* Knowledge of Workday Security Groups and domain security policies as they relate to data privacy and report visibility.
* Stakeholder Management \& Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a proven track record of effectively consulting with and influencing Stakeholders and non\-technical business partners.
* Automation \& Process Improvement: Strong track record of automating manual reporting processes, optimizing complex reports for speed and scalability, and driving operational efficiency.

* Operational Discipline: Strong operational background with demonstrated experience managing ticket queues, balancing dynamic priorities, and consistently hitting tight SLAs/KPIs in a high\-volume environment.

 A test is defined in the Independent Testing Enterprise Policy as “An independent point\-in\-time examination of one or more processes, controls, policies and procedures or data sources utilized for managing risk to assess the effectiveness of the control environment. A test is focused on answering a specific objective and has a pre\-defined pass/fail criteria.” Compliance testing may include activities such as automated surveillance and transaction level testing and may be performed onsite.
